name: 📜 Shell We Begin
prompt: Six Bash behavior graphs, none of which will ever run. Read them like a native: map the adapters, count the stages, tag the ATT&CK techniques, and pull the exact indicators hiding in the final bytes.

questions.question: Classify host-context.sh as benign_utility, stager, dropper, downloader, launcher, or staged_chain.
Recover the primary MITRE ATT&CK technique ID, or none.

answer_format.syntax: T#### or T####.###; use the literal none only when the question permits it

questions.question: Recover the exact native Bash adapter named by the command plan.

answer_format.syntax: exact artifact-derived value only, without quotes or explanatory text unless quotes are part of the value

questions.question: Recover the exact synthetic campaign identifier.

answer_format.syntax: exact artifact-derived value only, without quotes or explanatory text unless quotes are part of the value

questions.question: Recover the exact host_id indicator.

answer_format.syntax: exact artifact-derived value only, without quotes or explanatory text unless quotes are part of the value

questions.question: Recover the exact number of modeled stages.

answer_format.syntax: base-10 integer with no explanatory text

questions.question: Recover the ordered behavior graph using > separators.

answer_format.syntax: exact tokens joined by > with no surrounding spaces or explanatory text
